title: A closing PR is held to the acceptance/<issue>/ convention, the runner logs in with a session, and a failed spec reads as a failure in ci-feedback.json

criteria.given: a PR body that closes an issue at or above the rollout cutoff and no acceptance/<issue>/ spec
criteria.then: the convention check fails and names the missing directory; with the cutoff unset nothing is enforced

criteria.given: the same PR with the spec shipped, or labelled acceptance-waived on a docs-or-tests-only change
criteria.then: the convention check passes; the waiver is refused when a production file changed

criteria.given: an api spec with "auth": "session" and SAIKU_ACCEPTANCE_USER / SAIKU_ACCEPTANCE_PASSWORD in the environment
criteria.then: the runner logs in at /rest/saiku/session and sends the session cookie on later steps; without credentials the spec is not-run, never a pass

criteria.given: an acceptance run in which a spec failed
criteria.then: ci-feedback.json carries the acceptance verdict, reports status failed and offers a repro, and its schemaVersion does not move
